summary: Pre-market signalled a 850-900 point gap down to ~17,350 but Nifty rallied 200 points in the first 45 minutes; Bank Nifty surged 900 points intraday as banks led while IT lagged. Speaker switched to buying Bank Nifty calls mid-session after noticing the divergence.

events.claim: Nifty fell from 18,000 to 17,400 in 2-3 sessions; pre-market print showed ~850-900 point gap down
CreditSights (a Fitch Group unit) released a report flagging Adani Group as deeply leveraged; Adani Enterprises fell ~150 rupees intraday before recovering
FII cash market net buyers of 563 crore; DIIs net sellers of 215 crore on 23 Aug 2022
Fed minutes (18 Aug) signalled more rate hikes ahead

lessons: When banks lead while IT drags, redirect option buying to the stronger index (Bank Nifty).
A pre-open crash print with an immediate 200-point reclaim signals bulls shaking out weak hands.
quote: The momentum was so strong that I became an option buyer.
leaks: Hi, this is P. R. Sundar

summary: US fell a third straight day (Dow -1,000pts/~3% at 34,000; Nasdaq 100 -900pts/~6-7% from 13,750 to 12,850). Expects US bottom in a day or two; India likely settles 17,400-17,800 by expiry. Focus stocks: IT under margin-pressure news, Reliance strong on >$100 Brent, Cipla long idea.

events.claim: Dow Jones fell about 1,000 points (~3%) over three sessions to ~34,000; Nasdaq 100 fell ~900 points (6-7%) from ~13,750 to ~12,850
Brent crude crossed $100 after Saudi Arabia signalled production cuts
Adani Group announced takeover/offer for NDTV; speaker notes Adani had overtaken Ambani as Asia's richest person
IT companies cutting variable pay amid margin pressure (news report)

lessons: In a correction, watch which heavyweight refuses to fall - Reliance strength on high crude signalled informed positioning.
Delivery-percentage surges in large caps are a footprint of informed accumulation.
quote: Higher crude prices will always bring some jitteriness to Indian stock markets.

summary: Nifty oscillated 17,500-17,600, then short-covered in the last half hour to close above 17,600; mid/small caps outperformed while Infosys and TCS fell (TCS down ~140-150 over two weeks). Adani Enterprises saw a huge last-hour short covering. Speaker sold calls into the dip and got squeezed.

events.claim: TCS fell nearly 140-150 rupees over one-two weeks; Adani Enterprises saw heavy last-hour short covering on 24 Aug 2022
17,600 weekly straddle traded ~120 rupees combined premium, implying a 17,480-17,720 expiry range
FII cash net buyers 20 crore, DIIs sellers 220 crore - negligible institutional activity pre-expiry

lessons: Negligible institutional flows into expiry imply a low-volatility, range-bound resolution.
Closing above the expiry pivot strike is a meaningfully bullish tell.
quote: So many times, the market proved that we are wrong.

summary: US bounced as predicted from oversold. Framework: if Nasdaq 100 crosses 12,970 and holds an hour, go long - it had crashed 13,650 to 12,800 in 3-4 days. Markets overreact both ways; pre-event (Jackson Hole) positioning often recovers on event day. Delivery surges in HDFC twins read as informed bottom-fishing.

events.claim: Nasdaq 100 fell from ~13,650 to ~12,800 in 3-4 sessions; a sustained break above 12,970 was flagged as the long trigger
Jackson Hole symposium due Friday 26 Aug 2022; Germany GDP data due 25 Aug
HDFC twins and Sun TV showed unusually high delivery percentages

lessons: Compare recovery percentages across markets: India reclaiming 30-50% of its fall while the Dow reclaims 10% signals relative strength.
Markets overreact in both directions - extreme oversold plus stabilising longs is a bounce setup.
quote: If it crosses 12,970 and holds for more than one hour, it is time to go long in Nasdaq.
leaks: political-affiliation disclaimer mentioning DMK/BJP (drop politics, keep neutrality)

summary: Expiry-day treachery: after a firm morning with European/US futures green, selling began at 1pm - Nifty fell ~250 points from high, Bank Nifty 600+. Yet institutional flows were net positive (FII +375cr, DII -335cr). Adani Enterprises whipsawed again. A good series ended with a bad expiry day.

events.claim: 25 Aug 2022 expiry-day reversal: Nifty -250 from intraday high, Bank Nifty -600+, with the final 30 minutes (2:45-3:15pm) contributing ~150 points of Nifty's fall
Institutional flows net positive (~+40 crore) despite the sharp sell-off

lessons: Gap-up opens attract sellers - fade early enthusiasm rather than chase it.
On expiry day, flows and price can decouple completely; never infer positioning from price alone.
quote: If I have to explain today's market in one word: treacherous.

summary: US event-week choreography: down 5/4/3 days before Jackson Hole, up 2/1 days before. Cooling PCE data lifted Dow futures ~250 points on the 'good news is bad news' logic. Nifty gapped up 100+ but faded as US futures slipped. September: 5-week, ~25-session series with a Fed meeting; consolidation expected.

events.claim: US personal consumption expenditure data showed slowing spending; Dow futures rallied ~250 points from lows ahead of Powell's Jackson Hole speech at 7:30pm IST
India VIX fell nearly 7% on 26 Aug 2022
FII cash sellers only 51 crore; DIIs bought 453 crore

lessons: In a tightening cycle, weak demand data is bullish for equities - 'good news is bad news' inverted.
The 15 minutes around a Fed chair's speech is a defined risk window; reduce size into it.
quote: For the stock market, good news is bad news and bad news is good news.
leaks: flying back from Singapore to Chennai (travel/residency hint)
'Lowell Street Week Ahead' (ASR of Dalal Street)

summary: Black Monday: SGX Nifty -380/400, the year's biggest gap-down since Russia's invasion (24 Feb). Powell's hawkish-nothing speech Friday knocked Dow -1,300 over two sessions and Nasdaq 100 13,200 to 12,400. Teaches an opening Bank Nifty short straddle with 60-point stops risking ~1% of margin. Hopes rest on Reliance AGM.

events.claim: After Jackson Hole (26 Aug), Dow fell ~1,300 points over two sessions; Nasdaq 100 fell ~800 (13,200 to 12,400)
29 Aug 2022 was the biggest Indian gap-down of 2022 after 24 Feb (Russia-Ukraine war outbreak)
US announced export bans/restrictions on advanced chips to Russia and China; Nvidia fell ~6% more
Richest Americans reportedly lost ~$78 billion in market value after Powell's speech

lessons: An opening straddle right after a huge gap-down, with symmetric tight stops, risks roughly 1% of margin for outsized premium-capture.
One nine-minute speech can erase weeks of gains - cap exposure into known event windows.
quote: The entire bullishness can be wiped out by one person's nine-minute speech.
leaks: 'bear cartel' speculation (unverified, present as opinion or drop)

summary: Second-biggest gap-down of the year (>400 points) yet Nifty recovered ~200 points with no help from Asia, Europe or US futures - 'down but not out'. Institutional selling was trivial (~-400 crore net) against a 3,000-4,000 crore norm. Dollar index at 20-year high, rupee at record low. Reliance AGM disappointed.

events.claim: 29 Aug 2022: second-highest gap-down of 2022; Nifty recovered ~200 points from the low with no global recovery behind it
US dollar index hit a 20-year high; Indian rupee hit a fresh all-time low
Reliance AGM (29 Aug) disappointed - no Jio/Retail IPO timelines; stock fell ~50 rupees 2pm-3:15pm, closed ~2,600
Nasdaq fell ~5% on Friday post-Powell; Nasdaq 100 fell 13,200 to 12,400

lessons: A market that recovers on a day nothing global recovers is telling you locals absorbed the panic.
If India VIX closes at the day's low despite a crash, premiums never spike - straddles can survive a gap-down.
quote: Our market is really resilient - down, but not out.
leaks: 'so is my shirt also' / 'thumbnail today' (video artifacts)

summary: US in day-two hangover; Asia ignoring it. Three green flags: SGX Nifty above yesterday's high, US recovered only a third of its fall, and FIIs barely sold (~-560 crore) with only ~11k fresh index shorts at ~66% short - fuel for covering. Reliance held post-AGM. Sold 17,800PE ~500 points away; September range 16,500-18,000.

events.claim: FIIs held ~66% short in index futures (normal band 55-65%) with only ~11k contracts added on the crash day
Reliance fell only ~1% in a -2% market despite a disappointing AGM
Reliance announced ~2 lakh crore 5G investment (vs Airtel's ~4 lakh crore market cap); no Jio/Retail IPO timeline given

lessons: Short creation is fuel: without fresh shorts there can be no short-covering rally.
In event uncertainty, sell only far out-of-the-money premium - 500 points of buffer is a position, 50 is a hope.
quote: In the short term the market is about shorting and short covering; only in the long term is it about the economy.

summary: One-day reversal: Nifty wiped out the gap-down and closed at day's high, +600 from Monday's low; Bank Nifty swung ~2,500 points in two sessions. FIIs bought 4,000+ crore - first heavy buy in a long time - and even the rupee firmed. All 50 Nifty stocks closed green after Monday's all-red session. Highest OI shifted to 18,000CE.

events.claim: 30 Aug 2022: Nifty +600 intraday swing, all 50 Nifty constituents closed green; FII cash buying >4,000 crore
Call writers at 17,300-17,600 (post-crash) were forced to cover in the rally

lessons: Option sellers who write calls into a bearish narrative become the fuel of the reversal.
Momentum days rewrite the OI map - yesterday's resistance strike becomes the next pivot.
quote: From most bearish to most bullish, we have done it in just one day.

summary: Decodes Tuesday's 300-point rally as short covering, not FII conviction: SGX Nifty already -300/400 next morning. US futures down ~700 points since Tuesday's close; S&P 500 broke the 50% (3,980) and 61.8% retracements of its June-August swing, pointing to a 100% retest of the June low. Cleveland Fed hawkish: rates above 4% through 2023. Chip-export ban hits Nvidia.

events.claim: S&P 500 (June low ~3,625, high ~4,325) broke the 50% retracement at ~3,980 and then the 61.8% level - 100% retest of June low became the base case
Cleveland Fed official said rates would stay above 4% through 2023
US chip export restrictions to Russia and China; Nvidia fell another ~6% (after ~20% slide since a politician's share sale)
US futures down ~700 points between Tuesday close and Thursday pre-open

lessons: Post-crash FII cash buying can be short covering - check futures premium for conviction.
When the 50% and 61.8% retracements fail, plan for the 100% retest rather than hoping for support.
quote: You have to pay money to the market when the markets are volatile.

summary: Kangaroo market: Bank Nifty gapped down 700, surged 800 to take the swing high (~39,800), fell 700 again, then recovered 400 late. Nifty was calmer - TCS/Infosys (Nasdaq) and Reliance (export-duty hike on petrol/diesel/ATF plus a ~10% crude crash to ~$95) dragged. Crude's fall lifted autos; metals lagged weak Australia. FIIs U-turned to sell 2,300 crore.

events.claim: Government raised export duties/taxes on petrol, diesel and aviation turbine fuel (affecting Reliance/ONGC)
Crude oil crashed ~10% in two sessions (~$105 to ~$95)
1 Sep 2022 was reported as India's highest-ever F&O turnover day
FII cash -2,300 crore after +4,000 crore the previous day; DIIs +950 crore

lessons: One macro print splits the index: a crude crash lifts autos and OMCs while sinking oil producers - trade the split, not the headline.
A stock diverging from its twin on heavy OI addition (Bajaj Finserv vs Bajaj Finance) is a momentum candidate.
quote: Monday was the bear, Tuesday was the bull, and today is a kangaroo market.

summary: Five straight US down days, then a green close with a last-10-minute spike - smart money covering shorts before tonight's non-farm payrolls (expectation ~300k; Fed shift from 50bp to 75bp after Jackson Hole). Nasdaq down 1,500+ from highs. India outperforming; auto sales strong; VIX ~20. CPI on 13 Sep: from 8.5% to below 8.5% expected. IT recovery math toward 18,600.

events.claim: US non-farm payrolls due 2 Sep 2022 (~300k expected, prior 528k); Fed hike odds shifted from 50bp to 75bp after Powell's Jackson Hole tone
US CPI due 13 Sep 2022; prior 8.5%, sub-8.5% expected
Nasdaq and Dow down ~1,500 points from recent highs; India VIX near 20

lessons: The last ten minutes before a US holiday-weekend close reveals institutional positioning.
Index math: a 50% IT-sector bounce adds ~2% to Nifty given sector weight - know your multipliers.
quote: In the last five-ten minutes there was a spike - smart people covering shorts ahead of the key event.

summary: Pre-payroll squaring made every hour violent. TCS/Infosys negative all day; Reliance weak on export-duty plus crude; HDFC twins oddly strong. FIIs barely sold (-9 crore) but DIIs sold 670 crore. US payrolls came in-line at 315k vs ~300k expected - and oversold US rallied anyway ('no bad news is good news'). Adani Enterprises to enter Nifty 50.

events.claim: US August non-farm payrolls: 315k vs ~300k expected (prior 528k)
Adani Enterprises to replace Shree Cement in the Nifty 50 effective 30 September 2022 (second Adani stock, after Adani Ports)
Adani Enterprises hit a fresh all-time high; Vodafone Idea spiked ~10% and faded

lessons: In-line data can still ignite an oversold market - positioning, not the print, decides the reaction.
Don't carry weekend option risk without a specific edge; theta pays those who flatten.
quote: No bad news is good news.
leaks: 'I do have some shares... Vodafone Idea' (personal holdings)

summary: Hong Kong (-1.5%, one of only two global markets 30%+ off highs) drags SGX Nifty to ~17,510. Russia's gas halt to Europe is already priced - crude +1.5%. Financials strong vs non-financials weak. Teaches a live call calendar: long 17,500CE monthly, short 17,500CE weekly, harvesting faster near-term decay. Futures premium collapsed ~100 to ~15-20 points.

events.claim: Russia (Gazprom) halted Nord Stream gas deliveries to Europe indefinitely (announced 2 Sep 2022); crude rose only ~1.5% on the news
Nifty futures premium collapsed from ~100 points to ~15-20 points over the series
Hong Kong was down more than 30% from its prior-year high (alongside Nasdaq Composite)

lessons: Calendar spread mechanics: same strike, buy far month, sell near month - the near leg's faster decay is the edge.
Futures premium is a froth gauge; its collapse warns that bullish conviction has drained.
quote: Nifty is short below 17,390 and long above 17,780 - in between, it is choppy consolidation.
leaks: 'I also sold a lot of 17,800 call options' (self-position, genericize)

summary: Cues now flow from India to the world, not the reverse. Russia-gas is a non-event; Europe recovered most of Friday's gains. FIIs at ~81% short in index futures - suspiciously extreme - so cash selling may be hedged by futures buying. ITC at 2017 GST-era highs. FinNifty expiry-day far-strike sales (~5-6 rupees x 5,000 lots) as 'pocket money'. Exide OI addition to watch.

events.claim: FIIs held ~81% short position in index futures (vs ~85% earlier in the year)
OPEC+ agreed a production cut (6 Sep 2022), lifting crude
ITC rose from ~200 to ~330, approaching its 2017 GST-announcement-era high
Exide Industries added heavy open interest (midcap momentum watch)

lessons: Extreme short positioning makes headline cash selling unreliable - futures offsets can mask true flows.
Far-strike premium sales at scale (5-6 rupees x thousands of lots) are a legitimate theta-harvest for expiry week.
quote: Global markets are not taking cues from the US any more - they are taking cues from Indian markets.

summary: Teaching episode via the Suzlon saga: a report that ~10% of shares were pledged 'with Adani Green' was later clarified as a typo (pledged with SBI Capital) - yet the stock rallied ~30% in two days even after the correction. Parallels: the milkman court-case that erased 10,000 crore of market cap; Lakshmi Vilas Bank trading at 15-16 before going to zero. Broader market saw broad profit booking; only Reliance held it up.

events.claim: Suzlon share-pledge report naming Adani Green was clarified as a typo (SBI Capital); Suzlon still rallied ~30% in two sessions
FII +1,145 crore and DII +633 crore in cash on a down day (6 Sep 2022)
Lakshmi Vilas Bank equity was written off by RBI while shares still traded ~15-16 before going to zero

lessons: When a rumour is formally denied and the stock keeps rallying, the move is speculation, not investment.
Aggregate institutional buying cannot rescue a market-wide profit-booking day.
quote: Smart people are selling; the stupid people are buying.
leaks: 'I came out with a video' channel self-references

summary: US services PMI beat - and the market fell: 'good news is bad news'. US 10-year yield hit 3.5%, the highest in many years (next references: ~5.4% in 2007, ~15% in 1981). Nasdaq fell a sixth straight day; S&P broke 3,900 and analysts' supports across all three indices. Short candidates: TCS calls far out, HDFC AMC and OFSS (heavy short-side OI). SGX -200.

events.claim: US 10-year Treasury yield hit ~3.5%, highest in over a decade (references: ~5.4% in 2007, ~15% in 1981)
US ISM services PMI beat expectations, pushing yields up and equities down
NASDAQ fell for a sixth consecutive session; S&P 500 broke the 3,900 support flagged by US analysts (Nasdaq 12,000, Dow 31,000 also breached intraday)

lessons: When good economic news sells risk assets, the regime is inflation fear - sell rallies, not dips.
In downtrends, short the weakest names with OI confirmation (HDFC AMC, OFSS) rather than the index.
quote: Nowadays, good news is bad news for US markets.
leaks: 'I am selling call options aggressively in TCS' (self-trade)

summary: Extraordinary local strength: despite an eighth straight Nasdaq decline and red Europe, Nifty future recovered to 17,680/17,650. Surprise: the IT index itself bounced ~2% from lows (TCS led) while HDFC twins and ICICI were sold. India crossed 10 crore demat accounts. FIIs bought 758 crore. Bank Nifty call writers at 39,500/39,600 face squeeze risk. ECB +75bp tomorrow.

events.claim: India's demat accounts crossed 10 crore (September 2022)
FII cash +758 crore despite global weakness; DIIs -138 crore
ECB expected to hike 75bp on 8 Sep 2022; Fed Beige Book due the same evening

lessons: Every successful defense of a level (17,500) upgrades it into the floor for the next leg.
Heavy call-writing just above a rebounding index is squeeze fuel.
quote: A bull market will always climb the wall of worries.
leaks: 'I do have some shares... Vodafone Idea' (personal)

summary: US finally rallied (Beige Book timing) on oversold conditions; Nasdaq +300, S&P +100. ECB decision after Indian close (75bp likely, 100bp possible with double-digit European inflation). Yesterday's Bank Nifty call writers (39,500/39,600) will cover into strength. Crude -4% favours autos/OMCs (IOC at ~10% dividend yield, 2-3 P/E); Idea spiked 10% on telecom speculation. His book: long 17,600CE, short 17,800CE and 17,500PE.

events.claim: US markets rallied ahead of the ECB decision; Nasdaq +~300 points, S&P +~100 (7 Sep 2022 session)
Crude oil fell more than 4%
IOC cited as trading at ~10% dividend yield and 2-3 P/E (value framing)

lessons: Bear-market rallies are violent because they are short-coverings, not conviction - respect them, but don't extend them.
Bear-phase value screens work: OMCs at 2-3 P/E with double-digit yields are where traders hide.
quote: Bear-market rallies are very powerful; bull markets move slowly.
leaks: 'I also have a lot of positions' (self)

summary: Fantastic rally: from SGX <17,500 on Wednesday to a close above 17,800; Bank Nifty reclaimed 40,000 for the first time since it broke down on 28 Oct 2021 (peak ~41,800; trough ~32,000-32,250 - an 18,000-point round trip in a year). He sold 40,000CE/39,000PE (500 wide) and still needed rescue. ECB hiked 75bp; jobless claims 'too good' so US fell. FIIs +2,913 crore; ICICI Bank at all-time high.

events.claim: Bank Nifty crossed 40,000 on 8 Sep 2022, first time since breaking 40,000 on 28 Oct 2021 (peak ~41,800, trough ~32,000-32,250)
ECB raised rates 75bp on 8 Sep 2022, as expected; European markets fell
FII cash +2,913 crore; ICICI Bank hit a fresh all-time high (first bank to do so)
India VIX fell ~6%; US VIX fell ~8%

lessons: Size Bank Nifty by its habit of 500-800 point moves - even 500-wide option books needed intraday rescue.
Index support levels ratchet up with each successful defense: 16,500 to 17,000 to 17,400 in one month.
quote: Bank Nifty has the habit of making 500 to 800 point moves on either side.
leaks: 'I sold 40,000 call option and 39,000 put option' (self-trade)
'my Sunday Dalal Street Week Ahead program' (self-reference)

summary: ECB 75bp done; Powell's mid-session speech read as less hawkish and US recovered with a +0.5% last-10-minutes burst. Now Nasdaq, S&P, Nifty and Bank Nifty are all technically long - but chasing 200 points after the signal risks buying the top. IT is 20-30% off highs vs banks near highs. Weekend logic: Friday mistakes cost three nights of sleep. Disbelief sustains rallies.

events.claim: ECB hiked 75bp (8 Sep); Powell's speech was interpreted as less hawkish, with a +0.5% US rally in the final 10 minutes
Nifty, Bank Nifty, Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500 all registered technically 'long' signals
Foreign brokerage target of 1,200 rupees cited for ICICI Bank (long term)

lessons: A 'technically long' signal is an entry zone, not a chase confirmation - enter near the trigger or wait for a pullback.
Rallies persist while disbelief persists; the crowd's entry marks the top.
quote: The market is always designed to reward only the minorities, not the majority.

summary: Opened +125 toward 18,000, then DIIs (>1,000 crore sold) booked profits in the first hour: Nifty -150, Bank Nifty -400 intraday before IT (TCS +100 from lows) led an afternoon recovery; closed ~17,850. ICICI Bank and SBI fresh all-time highs; Adani Port and ITC 52-week highs; Reliance the top drag. India VIX -3% (down ~10% in two days). Bond-index inclusion talk (~$30bn). US CPI Tuesday is the next pivot.

events.claim: FII cash +2,132 crore (third straight 2,000+ crore day); DIIs sold >1,000 crore
News that India may be included in a global (JPMorgan) bond index, with ~$30 billion of potential debt flows
US CPI due 13 Sep 2022: trajectory 9.1% to 8.5% to (expected) below 8%
ICICI Bank and SBI hit fresh all-time highs; Adani Port and ITC fresh 52-week highs

lessons: In low-VIX regimes, don't sell near-the-money options - premium cannot pay for surprise moves (Bank Nifty's 39,500/39,600 lesson).
Round numbers plus swing highs guarantee profit booking - plan exits into strength, not after it.
quote: When people do not expect it, that is when the violent move comes.

summary: Recorded from a conference. Asia and US futures firm, yet SGX Nifty slightly red - the variable is Reliance: a Jamnagar SEZ refinery unit (crude distillation + FCC) shutting for 3-4 weeks of 'maintenance' creates revenue/profit uncertainty. Heavy call OI at 17,900/18,000 hints at informed caution. US CPI tomorrow is make-or-break but largely priced. His week: short 17,600PE and 18,200CE.

events.claim: Reliance announced shutdown of a crude distillation unit and fluidised catalytic cracker at its Jamnagar SEZ refinery for 3-4 weeks of maintenance (September 2022)
US CPI due 13 Sep 2022, widely expected to fall below the prior 8.5%

lessons: Refinery maintenance is a revenue event, not a footnote - price the lost throughput before the headline does.
Heavy call OI at round numbers ahead of binary data signals informed caution.
quote: Just like Russia says it is closing the Nord Stream pipeline for maintenance.
leaks: 'I am in Bangkok for a conference' (travel)

summary: CPI-day podcast: US rallied 5% (S&P) in five sessions into the data; RBI deputy governor's $100bn black-swan paper marked the bottom (+3,000 Nifty since). Nifty future crossed 18,000; 17,900/18,000 call sellers forced to cover. Bases ratcheted 16,500 to 17,000 to 17,500; advises not selling below 18,600. India CPI ~7% cooled the worry. FinNifty expiry plus US CPI = volatile Tuesday.

events.claim: S&P 500 rallied ~5% in five sessions into the 13 Sep CPI; Nasdaq +~800 points
RBI deputy governor's paper warning of a black-swan $100 billion outflow preceded a ~3,000-point Nifty rally
India August CPI came ~7% (released 12 Sep 2022)
Nifty futures crossed 18,000 (12-13 Sep 2022)

lessons: When markets rally into feared data, the squeeze usually resolves upward - respect the tape over the headline.
In an uptrend, ratchet your sold-strike floor up with the market instead of anchoring to old bases.
quote: Stock markets always climb the wall of worries.
leaks: 'I am in the conference in Bangkok' (travel)
Rakesh Jhunjhunwala anecdote (public figure - acceptable as attributed market anecdote)
'nearly 1800 point gap up' (likely ASR error for ~80-100 points - verify before use)
